field.label: Enable
field.help: Enforce parental control. When disabled the alias is emptied, so no device is blocked.

field.label: Alias name
field.help: The firewall alias holding currently blocked devices. Created automatically if missing, along with the rule that blocks it from reaching the internet.

field.label: Drop existing connections
field.help: When a device becomes blocked, drop its established connections. Without this an in-progress stream keeps running until it ends by itself.

field.label: Messaging apps to block
field.help: Apps blocked on every device whose Messaging setting blocks it. Notifications are cut on those devices whichever apps are chosen, even none. Facebook & Instagram blocks the whole Facebook, Instagram and Messenger apps, with Threads, Meta AI and "Log in with Facebook"; KakaoTalk also blocks other Kakao services such as Daum, Tistory, Melon and Kakao Map. Discord, Kik and WeChat are not offered because their servers are shared with other services.
